tasks.set: W-AD77-Daily Environmental Choices- Reducing Environmental Harm
tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.class: Daily Environmental Choices- Reducing Environmental Harm
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text:
This week, we're exploring ways people can reduce their environmental impact through daily choices. Consider these specific actions:
• Choosing to walk, bike, or take public transportation instead of driving
• Buying fewer new items and repairing them instead of replacing them
• Reducing energy use by unplugging devices
Which of these actions (or another specific environmental action) would be most effective for reducing environmental harm? Support your answer with specific examples of how this action works and what results it might produce.

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I believe reducing energy use is the most important thing we can do to protect the environment. If each person consumes a little bit less energy every day by unplugging devices, the result will be lower carbon emissions overall. And reducing carbon emissions helps combat climate change.

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: Personally, I think the most crucial action people can take to help the environment is to recycle and reuse materials instead of throwing them away in the trash. By minimizing the amount of waste they create, individuals can significantly reduce their environmental footprint and conserve natural resources.
